name: ZR2 Bioenergy Limited
about: ZR2 Bioenergy Limited operates as a bioenergy manufacturing company. It produces compressed biogas, ethanol, and potash. The company was formerly known as Gujchem Distillers India Limited and changed its name to ZR2 Bioenergy Limited May 2025. ZR2 Bioenergy Limited was founded in 1911 and is based in Mumbai, India.
